mode.description: Search toggle. 'semantic' (default) = pgvector cosine similarity with automatic full-text fallback when the query can't be embedded or returns no vector hits; 'lexical' = full-text token match only. Use 'lexical' for exact keyword/identifier lookups.

semantic.description: Deprecated back-compat alias for `mode`; when set it overrides mode (true=semantic, false=lexical).
